name: Afcons Infrastructure Ltd
title: Afcons Infrastructure Ltd - 544280 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 loss of INR 89 crore on payment stalls, one-offs and no margin recognition; FY26 order inflow INR 4,125 crore vs INR 30,000 crore FY27 target, and no revenue or margin guidance.
